slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 finished essentially flat at 7,764.64, down less than a tenth of a percent, while the Nasdaq 100 rose 0.81% as tech led and financials fell sharply. Oil dropped 6.19% to 89.85 per barrel, press coverage suggests on hopes Iran may reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and that tailwind lifted growth stocks. The VIX, which measures fear priced into the market, fell to 14.21, meaning traders are calmer than yesterday. Unemployment claims are due Thursday and revised consumer sentiment on Friday.
